objective.primaryRule: No primary and no roles: nothing is searched, ranked or selected (adaptation AD1). The study adopts standard 2.2.0 and builds and verifies optional D1 risk controls; its outcomes are pass/fail engineering gates G0-G7 (PROTOCOL.md section 12).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: No search proposals. backendEvaluations caps all fresh pooled simulations on real data: G1 New L0 on FULL (legacy only), G3 New L0 on D19/D21/D23/D24, G4 60 random configurations x D21/D24 (legacy), G5 120 random (configuration, controls) pairs on D24 with causal prefixes on D21 (invariants only; no performance figure recorded, AD7). Synthetic test runs are not counted.
